threads.body:
Towncrier is configured to manage `CHANGELOG.md`, but the config does not set `extension`/`template` for Markdown fragments. Towncrier defaults to `extension = "rst"` (and its built-in template is RST-oriented), so `*.md` fragments like `217.breaking.md` may be ignored and/or `towncrier build` may fail with a missing template for `md`.

To make the documented workflow work, either (a) add a Markdown template + `extension = "md"`, or (b) switch fragments to the default `.rst` extension and update the docs accordingly.

replies.body: No code change needed. The pinned Towncrier 24.8.0 configuration already selects the Markdown default template for CHANGELOG.md, and the documented draft build successfully renders the existing .md fragments. Also, `extension` is not a supported Towncrier 24.8 config option, so adding it would be misleading.

+# Changelog fragments
+
+Towncrier is configured with `wrap = true`, so generated `CHANGELOG.md` output
+is wrapped during release note generation. Changelog fragments should use one
+logical line per fragment entry; when reviewing, ask contributors to remove
+manual hard wrapping from fragment text.

Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai/commit/5f5836983d530a7cd3170d1fe199f15fc6704e14.

Documented the valid Towncrier fragment types in the changelog fragment instructions.

threads.body: `applyTo: "changelog.d/*.md"` will also apply these fragment-review instructions to non-fragment Markdown files in that directory (e.g. `changelog.d/README.md`). Since fragment files here follow `<pr>.<type>.md` (two dots), narrowing the glob avoids unintentionally scoping guidance to the README and any future docs under `changelog.d/`.
